info.description: Where this content came from, and when a human last checked it

sourceAuthority.description: Who the source is. Not used when this component sits on `authority` itself — an authority is its own source.

sourceUrl.description: Direct link to the source page. A plain string, not a uid — it is an external URL.

lastVerifiedAt.description: When a HUMAN last checked this against the source. Never written by the collector, the translation worker, or any automated job — #17's freshness monitoring depends on this meaning exactly that.

verificationStatus.description: Defaults to needs-review so nothing can be silently unmarked. Never inherited by a translation — #15/#16 set machine-draft.
